name: app-ground-rules
description: Ground rules for every app project: forbidden behaviour, threat-model baseline, stages, revert test, estimates and budget, process non-goals, git flow, the ARCHITECTURE.md overview and required state machines; journey-driven development: journey specs, flow tables, OpenSLO thresholds, OpenTelemetry journey events and the Goal QA loop; a dependency reviewer that checks a diff against the interfaces its goal depends on.
